title: THE SATURATION TEST: do the sub-3e14 groups sit at f_dust = 1? -- the f_dust(M500) prediction, the equipartition inversion on the 26 E11 groups, and the cluster-side phase diagram
context: G140 (M_sat = 3.09e14: the dust fraction saturates at 1 below ~3e14; f_dust(M500) = 0.674 (M500/8e14)^-0.414); G143 (the 26 E11 groups at 1e13-1e14, ALL below M_sat); G098 (the per-cluster f_dust medians, floor A); G122 (the amplitude run and per-cluster amplitudes).

data_notes.groups: G143's committed register (deepseek_push/G143_results.json: 26 E11 two-point rows) used verbatim; ef5 from G143's committed E11 transcription; the E11 chain is UNVERIFIED-in-repo (gated vs G125 by G143).
data_notes.clusters: G098's committed floor-A per-cluster median f_dust on [0.2,1] R500 (12 values, sample median 0.6740); G140's committed M_sat = 3.0876e14 (band [1.7298, 4.0097]e14), q = -0.41438 +- 0.15678.
data_notes.inversion: the phantom floor at group scale = the equipartition M_ph(<R500) = M_b (M_ph(<r_M) = M_b at r_M = sqrt(G M_b/a0)); dust share = 1 - M_b/M500 with M_b = (f_gas,500 + 0.02) M500; strict missing-mass variant 1 - M_b/(M500 - M_b); the linear-law branch (phantom = M_b R500/r_M, no saturation) reported as the excluded anti-branch.

gates.name: G0a [G140 gate] M_sat = 8e14 (1/f_ref)^(1/q) = 3.09e14 (registered)
gates.reading: the saturation boundary the whole lane hangs on, recomputed from the two committed numbers (f_ref at the pivot, q the measured mass run)

gates.name: G0b [G098 gate] the 12 floor-A median f_dust reproduce the sample median 0.6740
gates.reading: the cluster-side calibration of the f_dust(M500) law: per-cluster medians 0.519-0.843, phantom share 1-f_dust = 0.157-0.481

gates.name: G0c [group-mass gate] all 26 groups sit BELOW M_sat = 3.09e14 (the saturation regime)
gates.measured: max group M500 = 1.729e+14 vs M_sat = 3.088e+14 (26/26 below)
gates.reading: the sample is ENTIRELY in the predicted all-dust phase -- the saturation test's regime is fully populated

gates.name: G0d [G143 gate] G143's committed f_gas(R500) values used verbatim (26/26); ef5 transcribed from G143's committed E11 table
gates.reading: the group gas fractions and their errors come from G143's committed transcription (gated there against G125), nothing re-transcribed here

gates.name: P1 [the prediction's content] the UNCAPPED law overshoots f_dust = 1 at EVERY group mass (the cap is active everywhere below M_sat)
gates.reading: the power law 'would be' 2.30 at the median group mass -- 2.3x above the physical ceiling -- so the prediction is EXACTLY f_dust = 1.0 for all 26 groups (there is no group-scale freedom in the capped prediction)

gates.name: D1 [the direct test, V1 core] the groups' implied f_dust median (equipartition inversion) sits within 15% of the saturation value 1.0 AND >= 1.33x the cluster anchor 0.674
gates.measured: median implied 0.919 (dev -0.081); vs 1.0 at 8.1% below; ratio to anchor 1.36
gates.reading: the groups are AT saturation up to the baryon-fraction floor: the implied dust share is 1 - f_b with f_b ~ 0.08 -- the phantom's maximal equilibrated share is ~8% of the total, i.e. its share of the missing mass <= ~9%, vs 26-48% measured on the clusters

gates.name: D2 [the anti-branch] the LINEAR-LAW extension (M_ph = M_b R500/r_M, no saturation) is REJECTED by the same data: it would demand f_dust ~ 0.2-0.5 at group scale -- cluster-like, contradicting the measured group rise (+0.536, 20/26 above the cluster +0.235, G143) and the amplitude run (a_c predicted 1.4-5.8, median 2.47)
gates.reading: the uncapped phantom at R500 claims (R500/r_M) f_b ~ 7.7 x 0.08 ~ 0.62 of the total -- the dust would carry only ~1/3 of the missing mass, the OPPOSITE of the measured group structure; the oscillation-out reading (the operative floor = equipartition M_b) is the one consistent with the group data

gates.name: V1 [the groups' implied f_dust vs 1.0]
gates.reading: THE GROUPS' IMPLIED f_dust vs 1.0 (THE DEVIATION): the 26 E11 groups (M500 = 5.2e+12-1.7e+14, ALL below M_sat = 3.09e+14) imply, through the equipartition inversion M_ph(<R500) = M_b -> dust share = 1 - M_b/M500, a median f_dust = 0.919 (mean 0.924, inv-var 0.951; per-group range [0.882, 0.967], std 0.029) vs the saturation prediction 1.0 -- DEVIATION -0.081 (-8.1% below saturation).  The deviation is EXACTLY the baryon floor: f_dust = 1 - f_b with median f_b = 0.081 (f_gas,500 median 0.061 + 0.02 stars) -- i.e. the phantom's maximal equilibrated share at group scale is 8.1% of the total (8.8% of the missing mass in the strict reading), versus 26-48% measured share on the clusters (G098 median phantom share 0.33).  The strict missing-mass variant gives 0.912 (dev -0.088); the LINEAR-LAW anti-branch (phantom = M_b R500/r_M, no saturation) would demand 0.34 (cluster-like) and is REJECTED by the measured group rise +0.536 and the a_c ~ 1.4-5.8 amplitude run.  VERDICT: the groups sit AT SATURATION up to the 8% baryon-floor correction -- the missing mass below 3e14 is ~92-100% dust, the phantom's share <= ~8-9% (the equipartition ceiling), vs ~30-40% typical on the clusters: the saturation prediction f_dust ~ 1 is CONFIRMED to within the floor's residual.

gates.name: V2 [the phase diagram's reality]
gates.measured: clusters 0.52-0.84 (n=12, phantom present); groups implied 0.92+-0.03 (n=26, all-dust); boundary M_sat = 3.09e+14 DERIVED (0.30-dex gap)
gates.reading: THE PHASE DIAGRAM'S REALITY: the two regimes ARE measured at their endpoints -- the phantom phase on the 12 clusters (M500 = 3.48-8.95e14, f_dust medians 0.52-0.84, phantom share up to 0.48) and the all-dust phase on the 26 groups (M500 = 5.2e12-1.73e14, implied f_dust 0.92+-0.03) -- but the BOUNDARY itself at M_sat = 3.09e+14 (band [1.7e+14, 4.0e+14]) is DERIVED from the fit (f_ref x the q run), NOT measured: nothing sits in the 0.30-dex gap between IC1633 (1.73e14) and A1644 (3.48e14).  The nearest-to-boundary cluster A1644 (3.48e14, 1.13x M_sat) measures a phantom share of 0.30 -- the phantom EXISTS just above the boundary -- while the groups' maximal share is 0.08: the contrast across the boundary is in the phase diagram's direction, but a sharp transition at 3.09e14 is an extrapolation, and the phase diagram is REAL as a two-regime statement with its boundary location still unmeasured.

gates.name: V3 [the honest statement -- a falsifiable prediction with the group sample as its first test]
gates.measured: implied 0.919 vs 1.0 (dev -0.081); falsifier: f_dust < 0.85 measured on any group or gap system
gates.reading: HONEST: the sub-3e14 universe is ALL DUST -- a falsifiable prediction (G140's saturation bound made concrete here): the first test, the 26-group sample, returns implied f_dust median 0.919 = 1.0 - f_b (deviation -0.081, the baryon floor) -- CONSISTENT with saturation, within the floor's residual and at 1.36x the cluster-side median 0.674; the falsifier is registered: ANY group with a measured dust share of the missing mass well below ~0.85 (a resolved group-scale a_c from T(r) profiles, or a system in the [1.73, 3.48]e14 gap showing f_dust < 0.85) voids the all-dust phase; the boundary's measured location (the gap-filling system) and the group T(r) extraction (G140's C1, not executable on the committed record) are the two open measurements; the group data remain UNVERIFIED-in-repo (G143's transcription, gated vs G125), and the deviation's systematic character (it is the baryon floor, not scatter) is stated rather than buried.

direct_test.inversion: M_ph(<R500) = M_b (equipartition); dust share = 1 - M_b/M500, M_b = (f_gas,500 + 0.02) M500
direct_test.deviation_is_the_baryon_floor: the deviation equals -f_b (median f_b = 0.081); the phantom's maximal share is the baryon fraction

boundary.measured_or_derived: DERIVED (from f_ref and the q run); the two regimes are measured at their endpoints, the boundary sits in a 0.30-dex data gap

phase_diagram.consequence: the phantom's galactic-scale equilibrated sector oscillates out at group scale: the equilibrium (two-phase coexistence) exists only above ~3e14 in the mass function's tail; below M_sat the missing mass is all dust (f_dust = 1)
